t: The Titan T1 electric pressure washer is a compact, lightweight cleaning solution for trade and site maintenance tasks. Powered by a 1400W motor, it delivers up to 110 bar pressure with a 420L/hr flow rate for effective cleaning of vehicles, tools and hard surfaces. The small footprint allows easy transport and storage, while onboard accessory storage keeps equipment organised. A 6m textile PVC hose and auto stop/start system support efficient, controlled operation. Suitable for domestic and light-duty professional use.
